topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I can't stop staring at these flowers. They're here, sitting on my kitchen table, a burst of color and life. But there's no card, no note, nothing to explain why they're here, who sent them. I keep thinking, maybe I missed something, a sign, a clue, a message somewhere in my day that could have prepared me for this. But there was nothing. It feels like a question, an open-ended one that hangs there, making everything else pale in comparison. I've tried to focus on other things, but they keep pulling me back, these beautiful, silent messengers with so many possible meanings.
